source_caption_text:
Ralfy The Plug Just RESTOCKED The Drakeo The Ruler Skateboards 🛹🔥 Long Live The Ruler 🕊️

Drakeo The Ruler, born Darrell Caldwell, was an influential Los Angeles rapper and one of the leading voices of the city’s underground rap scene. Known for his unusual flow, coded slang, laid-back delivery and creative wordplay, Drakeo developed a sound that helped influence a new generation of West Coast artists. Projects like Cold Devil, Thank You for Using GTL and The Truth Hurts became major parts of his catalog, and he also collaborated with artists including Drake and Don Toliver. Drakeo tragically d*** in December 2021 at just 28 years old, but his music and influence continue to have a major presence in L.A. rap. 

Ralfy The Plug is a Los Angeles rapper, a key member of the Stinc Team, and Drakeo The Ruler’s younger brother. The two brothers helped build the Stinc Team movement together and frequently collaborated, including on their 2021 project A Cold Day in Hell. Since Drakeo’s p******, Ralfy has continued releasing music, representing Stinc Team and keeping his brother’s legacy alive through music, merchandise and other projects connected to the movement. 

Together, Drakeo and Ralfy were more than collaborators—they were brothers who helped create their own lane in Los Angeles hip-hop, with Ralfy continuing to push the sound and legacy they built together. Long Live The Ruler 🕊️🐐
